title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Beacon Theatre, New York City | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Beacon Theatre in New York City, USA, on 23 May 2000.

It was the ninth show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at the Beacon Theatre on 16 and 17 February 1999. He returned there on 17 and 18 June 2014, 15 November 2017, and 6, 7, and 8 June 2022.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

They were joined for this show by The Police’s Andy Summers on guitar during ‘Theme For An Imaginary Western’, and the E Street Band’s drummer Max Weinberg on ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’.
